owner: db_domain owns the store and the scratch registry (charter gated_by CC; codemother owns the care of the code, ruling 2026-09-06). CC/Opus builds. The bus and the tester are the two callers.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> [WATCHME(scratch-stays-swept):waiting] -> PROVED

watchme.trigger: every tester seal after the crossing (sweep_scratch() runs there and returns a count)
watchme.enough: seven days after PROVED with the live table count equal to the registry's non-scratch rows plus alive-pid scratch at every seal, or the first seal where it is not, which reports the leaker by name
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier tooth (6): tables in pg_tables, rows in cairn_scratch, alive pids, sweep counts per seal
watchme.nexus: db_domain's tree (the store's own operational record)
watchme.consumer: codemother, as owner of the care of the code; the operator inbox if a leaker is named
